faqs.a:
(a)
The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this chapter, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
Alcoholic beverages
shall have the meaning set forth in C.R.S. § 44-3-103(2), as may be amended from
               time to time.
Applicant
shall mean and include:
(1)
If an individual, that person making an application for license or permit under this
                  chapter.
(2)
If a partnership, all the partners of the partnership which is making application
                  for a license under this chapter.
(3)
If a corporation, any officer, director, manager or any stockholder therein.
Authority
or
licensing authority
means the local licensing authority of the City of Arvada.
City clerk,
as used in this chapter, shall include the city clerk of the city or their designee.
Fermented malt beverage
shall have the meaning set forth in C.R.S. §§ 44-4-103(1)(a), (b) as may be amended
               from time to time.
Malt liquors
shall have the meaning set forth in C.R.S. § 44-3-103(30) as may be amended from
               time to time.
Manager
means and includes that person or those persons who manage, direct, supervise, oversee
               and administer the acts, transactions and acts of servants of the establishments governed
               by this chapter.
Open container
means any bottle, can, box, glass, or other device used for the storage and/or sale
               of beverage, which has had its cap or other permanent seal broken so as to allow access
               to its contents. Further, the words "open container" means any item used for the storage
               or transport of beverage which has no permanent cap, top, or sealer.
Person
whenever it appears in this chapter shall be deemed to include a natural person,
               partnership, association, company, corporation, organization or manager, agent, servant,
               officer or employee of any of them.
Public property
means any real property owned by the State of Colorado or any county, municipality,
               or other political subdivision thereof, or any special district.
Spirituous liquors
shall have the meaning set forth in C.R.S. § 44-3-103(54) as may be amended from
               time to time.
Vinous liquors
shall have the meaning set forth in C.R.S. §§ 44-3-103(59)(a), (b) as may be amended
               from time to time.
(b)
All other words and phrases used in this chapter not otherwise defined herein shall
               have the meanings attached by the state statutes regulating the sale of liquor and
               fermented malt beverages, or if not otherwise defined by law, are used in their common
               and accepted sense and meaning.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018)
State Law reference—
Definitions as to fermented malt beverages, C.R.S. § 44-4-103; definitions as to alcoholic
               beverages, C.R.S. § 44-3-103
